rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (8 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/479086-Radiohead-Itch, https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/radiohead-itch-japanese-cd-album-cdlp-tocp-8285-236093. Japan tour mini-album EP (Jun 1, 1994, Toshiba-EMI, TOCP-8285). Tracks 5-7 recorded live at Cabaret Metro, Chicago (Jun 30, 1993); track 8 is the acoustic KROQ version. Track 3 is 'Faithless, The Wonder Boy' per the booklet (rear artwork omits the space).
